summary: Iteration 3 retest of 2 HIGH bugs flagged in iteration_2. Both FIXED and verified end-to-end. Backend regression: 43/43 PASS (17 new-feature + 26 existing). Frontend Apply-on-web flow now triggers window.confirm (msg captured: 'Apply template?\nThis will add 9 placeholder items...'), POST /api/templates/{id}/apply fires, redirect to /grid happens, and grid renders 9/9 filled with GENERATE 27 OUTFITS CTA enabled. Grid 3x3 layout at 390px viewport: all 9 slots render at non-zero 103x103 with cols at x=33,144,254 (right-edge 357 < 390) and 3 rows at y=147,258,368 — LAYER column ('Light wool overshirt', 'Heavyweight zip hoodie', 'Beige trench coat') fully visible, no cropping.
action_items: Iteration_2 minor backend issues are still open (non-blocking for this iteration): (a) /api/templates/{id}/like idempotency per-user, (b) /api/templates/{id}/apply re-clones items every call, (c) /api/palette image-size DOS guard. Defer or schedule.
Iteration_2 code review notes still apply (server.py ~595 lines — split routers when >700).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix #1 (web confirm) is implemented inline at templates/[id].tsx — clean Platform.OS branch, async/await preserved, idempotent. Good.

Fix #2 (grid layout) replaced 32%-width flexWrap with nested rows: outer styles.grid is column flex with gap 8, styles.gridRow is row flex with gap 8 and flex:1, slot is flex:1. This is the correct CSS-grid-equivalent in RN — handles narrow viewports cleanly without any width:'32%' overflow. aspectRatio:1 keeps the box square.
Verified all 9 grid-slot-N testIDs are still attached and onLayout/measure logic is preserved for drag-target hit-testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 2 retested HIGH flows. Apply-on-web confirm + redirect: PASS. Grid 3-column rendering at 390px: PASS (all 9 slots 103x103, cols x=33/144/254 fit within 390px viewport).

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Reused test@packr.app/test1234 with seeded official templates from FastAPI startup hook. Apply call cloned 9 items into wardrobe (now 21 items) and overwrote trip grid — expected behavior per existing minor bug already documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_2 HIGH bugs are confirmed fixed by automated playwright run. Window.confirm path verified via stub — confirm() was called with correct message and apply API fired. Grid measurement at 390px shows 3 visible columns of equal width (103px) inside a 357px-wide content area, no overflow. Iteration_2 backend minors (like-idempotency, apply re-clone cleanup, palette DOS guard) and code-review observations remain open and were intentionally not in scope for this retest.
rca_of_issue: Resolved. (1) Apply-on-web RCA confirmed as RN-Web Alert.alert single-button reduction; the Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm restores the confirm UX and the apply codepath. (2) Grid LAYER cropping RCA was: each slot was width:'32%' inside a flexWrap row, which combined with internal padding (8px) + gap (8px) on a 390-24*2=342px content area exceeded available width and bumped the third column to a new line / off-screen depending on render order. Replacing with nested 3 rows of flex:1 row + slot flex:1 distributes 100% of available row width across exactly 3 children with deterministic gaps, eliminating the overflow class of bug entirely.
